prompt: Turn the person in this portrait into the character below, keeping exactly the same pixel-art style, outline weight, shading, pose, framing, lighting and flat dark background, with the same large, clearly drawn eyes, strong brows and defined mouth: a sly, feral young thief of eighteen, an adult, small, lean and wiry, with a narrow fox-like face: high sharp cheekbones, a small pointed nose, large dark narrowed eyes with thick dark upper-lid lines, bright irises and a single bright catchlight each, sharp dark brows, a wide tight-lipped smirk, black chimney soot smeared across both cheeks. Long, straight, ink-black hair streaked with ash-grey, loose past her shoulders, a ragged fringe swept to one side above her brows. A shredded charcoal cowl bunched around her neck and shoulders, a close-fitting jerkin of small overlapping slate-grey leather scales, a small tin whistle on a cord at her throat. Her hand is raised beside her chin holding a slim black dagger point-down, and thin wisps of grey smoke curl up from her fingertips. Head and shoulders, her whole body, shoulders and face turned three-quarters toward the right, looking right, her head filling most of the frame; large, clearly drawn eyes, strong dark brows, a large defined mouth, bold dark outlines. A plain, flat, empty dark background. Lighting: a soft, dim warm amber rim light from the right, its lamp far out of frame and never visible, gentle warm fill, deep warm brown shadows. A plain dark background with no lamp, lantern or light source in the frame.
